{{Top|leg}}
The '''plasma welder''' was a tool that could be used to penetrate or join just about any material known. They generally cost around fifty [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to purchase.<ref name="SWS">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref>
